gold_note: Slanted cladogram on a spine (classed slanted): under the out-of-scope ruling for slanted cladograms on a spine (otero2010a_fig15), flagged. Photographs of bones and a skeleton drawing fill the right of the image (panels b-e); the tree is panel a. Branches meet the stems of other branches part way up (Allosaurus+Carcharodontosauridae on the Spinosauroidea line, the Elaphrosaurus clade on the Ligabueino line, Aucasaurus on the Carnotaurus line). Printed clade names are on stems below their nodes. 17 tips, fully resolved; 5 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 10 case (census 3, seed 20261274).
